title: Pointwise composition of restrictions
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $r,s:[n]\to\{\text{free},\text{fixed at }1,\text{fixed at }-1\}$ be coordinate restrictions. Their composition is the coordinate restriction whose value at each coordinate is the composition of $r$ and $s$ there.
hypotheses_covered: Two functions from $[n]$ to the three coordinate restrictions
